What was checked

The exact exported report hashes to c09fb86520b06bb0f263e84e9e10336f1c0aa83db6f8a48247a743e295b15483. We decoded the receipt component’s public state and checked that its stored hash, inspected transaction ID, signer and epoch match the expected values.

The receipt transaction also called all five getters: report_hash, transaction_id, author, recorded_epoch and schema_version. The whole transaction committed. Individual return values are not exposed by the persisted execution response.

Limits

This is verification against public indexer responses, not independent validation of signatures or consensus proofs. A commitment proves neither report accuracy nor anonymity. The signer and inspected transaction link are public.

The live check used the developer-wallet manifest flow. The Sapient request flow has also completed a live mainnet receipt. View its verified evidence ↗. Three user submissions created duplicate receipts; each was accepted and charged 0.003550 TARI. No extra receipt is needed to review this evidence.
